public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve the migrated x axis when counting horizontal bars**

For saved horizontal bar charts with a legacy `granularity_sqla` but no `x_axis`, this returns zero bars even when the query returns multiple categories. `chart.ui_query_context()` normalizes the legacy column into `x_axis` through `charts/explore.py::_initial_values`, but `_chart_content()` passes the original, unnormalized params here. Consequently, twelve returned monthly categories are estimated as zero bars, potentially accepting a height that squeezes the chart or flagging a correctly sized chart as excessively tall. Resolve the effective axis using the same normalization as the query before counting categories.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L41-L44](https://github.com/jailtoncarlos/superset-api-plus/blob/94e0fc6b74aaa0a0209e2cc0c2fac5bb41203ce5/AGENTS.md#L41-L44)
